content.raw:
Pricing overview

Philosophy:

Our goal is to help you grow so we aligned our pricing model to your growth (or needs) so we are incentivized to help you grow.

 

Pricing Model:  "Revenue Under Analysis"

We offer to analyze and automate the reporting of $100M of ARR for $2,000 per month.

 

Discounts:

  • Partner discounts: 16% which is equivalent to two months free
  • Veterans (Military Service): 8% which is equivalent to one month free
    • Veteran discounts applied to businesses owned by a Veteran or the primary sponsor or Internal partner is a Veteran

Pricing details:

Seats:

  • The subscriptions below come with 5-seat licenses, and more can be purchased anytime during the contract for $30 per user per month.
  • Additionally, customer accounts can remove the additional seat license anytime during the contract as well.

Data source Instances

  • CRM:
    • One CRM instance integration comes with the subscription purchase.
    • Additional CRM integrations can be purchased for $2,000/mo per CRM instance

 

  • SMB Financial Suites:
    • Integration of a financial suite focused on small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) can be purchased for $2,000/mo per instance.
    • Examples: QuickBooks, Xero, etc.

 

  • Enterprise Financial Suites:
    • Integration of a financial suite for enterprises can be purchased for $4,000/mo per instance.
    • Examples: NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics

 

 

Meet with Sales
